# `browser-extension/services/BrowserCredentialVault.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/BrowserCredentialVault.js`

Extension-local encrypted browser credential records. Secret plaintext is accepted only by save() and returned only by the module-private readForActuation() method. Page/bridge callers receive status projections without selectors, plaintext, ciphertext, IVs, or secret size. A non-extractable AES-GCM key is stored as a structured-cloned CryptoKey in IndexedDB so Manifest V3 worker suspension does not weaken encryption.
